test_title: PYST 1: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov 2022 (Shift 3 )
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All girls are students.

All students are leaders.

Some leaders are brave.

**Conclusions:**

I. All girls are leaders.

II. Some girls are brave.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
__Statements:__

All girls are students.

All students are leaders.

Some leaders are brave.

__Venn Diagram:__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/075b60db5a5693760551d139f279424b55b34c94aaf0b31ac13d36b041c7d944.png] 

__Conclusions:__

I. All girls are leaders → Follow → Since 'all girls are students' and 'all students are leaders' it is safe to say that all girls are leaders and the same can be seen in the Venn diagram therefore the conclusion follows.

II. Some girls are brave → Does not follow → From the given information we have do data that suggests the relation between girls and brave and without any concrete evidence we cannot assume thus the conclusion does not follow.

So only conclusion I follows.

Hence the correct answer is "option (1)".
